text_block_list.text:
Um, is there a book I can use as drawing reference...!?
Ah~ oh no, oh no! There's no time~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The submission deadline is coming up~!
At this rate, we're gonna miss printing the new issue...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Traiineeeer?!!
How long have you been standing theeeere?!
choice_data_list: You didn't come to training, so I came looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! How could I do something so disrespectful to the race...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... W-What have I...
What on earth have I done...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she seemed to be deeply reflecting on it already,
I left it at a mild warning...
